redisEndpointAuthority: Current authenticated generated worker PID/startTicks/bootID → exactly one direct child with pinned Redis executable bytes/hash → unique child-owned kernel socket inode LISTEN on127.0.0.1 highport → readonly native PING/INFO process_id/run_id/tcp_port and CONFIG GET dir equal generated root/redis. Current process identities revalidated after readback.
directChildDiscovery: Bounded private-PID /proc numeric census, actual stat parentPID equals authenticated generated worker, exact PID/startTicks/bootID revalidated; no dependency on optional task/children interface.
